rationale: The answer is an evidence-backed architecture review and scores full marks on all nine dimensions. Scope/classification: it states the pnpm monorepo and desktop-package structure from multiple signals (pnpm-workspace.yaml, desktop/package.json, config, tests, history). Evidence: nearly every claim cites a path with a line number, and the answer explicitly distinguishes current evidence (implementation/config/tests) from stale intent (CLAUDE.md/ARCHITECTURE.md). I verified the security config, the E2E canary, WindowManager responsibilities (including findBestWindowToOpenIn), EditorWindow file-list/watcher ownership, the file-workflow split (project.ts sidebar ops via fileUtils/ipcRenderer), the permissive IPC contract and internal-channel mixing (window-file-saved typed tabId but handled as pathname), the editor-boundary any/shim/synthetic-history, files.ts open migration state, commands/index.ts any callback, internalIpc.ts helper, markdown.ts/filesystem/index.ts load/save semantics, the flush-on-save and content-identical-watcher tests, and the three-window-identity split. The options table covers status quo vs capability facade vs domain core with trade-offs, cost, risk, and rollback, and the six-step migration has observable acceptance criteria and reversibility. Generalization holds: MarkText specifics are kept project-local and not promoted to universal rules. Accuracy gate: no material errors; one minor misattribution (main 'parsing' markdown rather than file IO). Both documentation-vs-implementation disagreements the answer surfaced (stale sandbox docs; PARITY_SCOREBOARD PG14 xfail vs fixed test) are decision-relevant but were resolved by the answer in favor of current evidence, so unresolved_decision_conflict_count is 0 and the gate passes. Caveat: most of the cited git hashes could not be independently re-walked (no git tooling in this session), but the historical narrative is corroborated by in-repo PR references and code comments, and the one hash visible in the environment (c907b29c) matches the answer's description.
